bodies.originalContent:
name: Host process fixture acceptance

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review, converted_to_draft]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/host-process-acceptance.yml'
      - 'agent-teams-controller/**'
      - 'packages/legacy-agent-host/**'
      - 'packages/task-change-ledger/**'
      - 'src/features/agent-backend/**'
      - 'src/main/utils/ownedProcess/**'
      - 'src/main/utils/childProcess.ts'
      - 'src/main/utils/electronNodeLaunch.ts'
      - 'src/main/utils/linuxNodeExecArtifact.ts'
      - 'src/main/services/team/WorkspaceMcpBundle.ts'
      - 'test/main/build/electronBuilderAfterPack.test.ts'
      - 'test/features/agent-backend/**'
      - 'tools/owned-process-broker/**'
      - 'scripts/build/buildOwnedProcessBroker.ts'
      - 'tools/linux-node-exec/**'
      - 'scripts/build/buildLinuxNodeExec.mjs'
      - 'scripts/dev-with-runtime.mjs'
      - 'scripts/build/linuxNodeExec.native.test.mjs'
      - 'scripts/electron-builder/afterPack.cjs'
      - 'scripts/electron-builder/dist.mjs'
      - 'scripts/electron-builder/verifyLinuxNodeExec.cjs'
      - 'scripts/ci/**'
      - 'scripts/ensure-electron-install.cjs'
      - 'vendor/provider-migration/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

# Draft-safe process fixtures have their own evidence; existing native-provider gates remain intact.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number || (github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/')) && github.ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/') }}

jobs:
  process-fixtures:
    name: Host process fixtures (${{ matrix.platform }})
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - runner: ubuntu-24.04
            platform: linux-x64
            arch: x64
          - runner: macos-15
            platform: darwin-arm64
            arch: arm64
          - runner: macos-15-intel
            platform: darwin-x64
            arch: x64
          - runner: windows-2022
            platform: win32-x64
            arch: x64
          - runner: windows-11-arm
            platform: win32-arm64
            arch: arm64
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      HOST_PROCESS_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      HOST_PROCESS_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      # Use the exact Corepack bundled with the selected Node; avoid a second
      # package-manager bootstrap and native-engine self-switch on macOS Intel.
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Select the pinned package manager with bundled Corepack
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(corepack --version)" = 0.36.0
          corepack enable
          corepack install --global pnpm@11.22.0
          test "$(pnpm --version)" = 11.22.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Bind exact source and actual process tuple
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HOST_PROCESS_SOURCE_HEAD"
          node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; assert.equal(process.version,'v24.21.0'); assert.equal(process.platform+'-'+process.arch,process.env.HOST_PROCESS_PLATFORM)"
          mkdir process-acceptance-evidence
          git rev-parse HEAD > process-acceptance-evidence/source-head.txt
      - name: Install frozen workspace without Desktop postinstall
        run: node scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
      - name: Build existing controller and Host
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc -p packages/task-change-ledger/tsconfig.json
          node agent-teams-controller/scripts/build.mjs
          node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc -p packages/legacy-agent-host/tsconfig.json
          node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc -p packages/legacy-agent-host/tsconfig.test.json
          node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tools/owned-process-broker/tsconfig.json
          node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tools/owned-process-broker/tsconfig.retained-host.json
      - name: Verify process contracts and retained Main Host transport
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/claude-management-host.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/scheduled-run-host.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/management-command-store.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/owned-process-facade.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/windows-job-custody.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-owner.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-capture-records.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-commands.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-linux-warm-lifetime.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-build-selection.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/lifecycle-process-release.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/windows-provider-routing.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/windows-launcher-recipe.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/windows-finite-process-routing.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/runtime-source-process-selections.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/runtime-source-probe-origins.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/management-model-probe.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/saved-team-model-probe.test.ts 2>&1 | tee process-acceptance-evidence/host-contracts.log
          node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --maxWorkers=1 --config tools/owned-process-broker/vitest.config.ts 2>&1 | tee process-acceptance-evidence/protocol.log
          node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --maxWorkers=1 test/features/agent-backend/capturedHostClient.test.ts test/features/agent-backend/capturedWindowsSelection.test.ts test/features/agent-backend/desktopBackendFeature.test.ts test/features/agent-backend/fileTeamModelProbeIntents.test.ts test/features/agent-backend/capturedRuntimeSourceNativeAdmission.test.ts test/features/agent-backend/capturedWindowsSourceHistory.test.ts test/features/agent-backend/capturedWindowsSourcePending.test.ts test/features/agent-backend/hostOpenCodeV2ModelProbeLifecycle.test.ts 2>&1 | tee process-acceptance-evidence/retained-main.log
      - name: Verify original POSIX Node and shell lifecycle fixtures
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/captured-claude-process.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/runtime-source-native-identity.test.ts 2>&1 | tee process-acceptance-evidence/posix-lifecycle.log
      - name: Prepare pinned Electron for native process fixtures
        if: runner.os != 'macOS'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/ensure-electron-install.cjs --strict
          node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import {createRequire} from 'node:module'; assert.equal(createRequire(import.meta.url)('electron/package.json').version,'44.10.1')"
      - name: Verify Linux Node exec descriptor closure under both original parents
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          HOST_NODE_EXEC_TARGET="$(command -v node)" node --test scripts/build/linuxNodeExec.native.test.mjs 2>&1 | tee process-acceptance-evidence/linux-node-exec-node24.log
          HOST_NODE_EXEC_TARGET="$(command -v node)" ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 node_modules/electron/dist/electron --test scripts/build/linuxNodeExec.native.test.mjs 2>&1 | tee process-acceptance-evidence/linux-node-exec-electron.log
          node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --maxWorkers=1 test/main/build/electronBuilderAfterPack.test.ts 2>&1 | tee process-acceptance-evidence/linux-node-exec-packaging.log
      - name: Qualify original Linux pidfs and retained pidfd under Host Node
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          LEGACY_REGISTERED_PROCESS_NATIVE_GO: '1'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          headers=$(node -p "require('path').resolve(require('path').dirname(process.execPath),'../include/node')")
          node packages/legacy-agent-host/scripts/qualifyLinuxProcessNative.ts "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-process-node24-$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$(command -v cc)" "$(command -v readelf)" "$headers" 2>&1 | tee process-acceptance-evidence/linux-node24.log
          cp -R "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-process-node24-$GITHUB_RUN_ID" process-acceptance-evidence/linux-node24
      - name: Qualify original Linux pidfs and retained pidfd under Electron Node
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          LEGACY_REGISTERED_PROCESS_NATIVE_GO: '1'
          ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: '1'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          headers=$(node -p "require('path').resolve(require('path').dirname(process.execPath),'../include/node')")
          node_modules/electron/dist/electron packages/legacy-agent-host/scripts/qualifyLinuxProcessNative.ts "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-process-electron-$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$(command -v cc)" "$(command -v readelf)" "$headers" 2>&1 | tee process-acceptance-evidence/linux-electron.log
          cp -R "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-process-electron-$GITHUB_RUN_ID" process-acceptance-evidence/linux-electron
      - name: Build original Windows product broker and C++ fixtures
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $build = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'TEST-process-build-${{ matrix.arch }}'
          $stage = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'TEST-process-stage-${{ matrix.arch }}'
          $scoped = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'TEST-process-scoped-stage-${{ matrix.arch }}'
          $cmake = (Get-Command cmake.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
          node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/build/buildOwnedProcessBroker.ts '${{ matrix.arch }}' $build $stage $cmake
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native fixture build or product staging failed' }
          $staged = @(Get-ChildItem -File $stage | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name)
          if ((($staged | Sort-Object) -join ',') -ne 'manifest.json,owned-process-broker.exe') { throw 'Unexpected staged fixture' }
          "HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_BUILD=$build" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
          "HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_STAGE=$stage" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
          Copy-Item "$stage\manifest.json" process-acceptance-evidence/windows-manifest.json
          node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/build/buildOwnedProcessBroker.ts '${{ matrix.arch }}' $build $scoped $cmake service-scopes-v1
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Scoped native fixture build or product staging failed' }
          $scopedFiles = @(Get-ChildItem -File $scoped | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name)
          if ((($scopedFiles | Sort-Object) -join ',') -ne 'manifest.json,owned-process-broker.exe') { throw 'Unexpected scoped stage fixture' }
          "HOST_PROCESS_SCOPED_STAGE=$scoped" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
          Copy-Item "$scoped\manifest.json" process-acceptance-evidence/windows-scoped-manifest.json
          Get-ChildItem -File "$build\Release\*.exe" | Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 | Format-List | Out-File process-acceptance-evidence/windows-binary-sha256.txt
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path native-evidence | Out-Null
          Copy-Item process-acceptance-evidence/windows-binary-sha256.txt native-evidence/binary-sha256.txt
      - name: Qualify original Windows Job and control under Host Node
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $build = $env:HOST_PROCESS_NATIVE_BUILD
          $controller = "$build\Release\owned-process-gate-controller.exe"
          $node = (Get-Command node.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source

      - name: Require completed original platform receipts and unchanged source
        run: |

          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HOST_PROCESS_SOURCE_HEAD"
          git diff --exit-code
          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
          import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
          import { join } from 'node:path';
          const directory = 'process-acceptance-evidence';
          const rows = name => readFileSync(join(directory, name), 'utf8').split('\n')
            .filter(line => line.startsWith('{')).map(line => JSON.parse(line));
          const native = [];
          if (process.platform === 'linux') {
            for (const name of ['linux-node24.log', 'linux-electron.log']) {
              const completed = rows(name).filter(row => row.automaticAndWarm === true);
              assert.equal(completed.length, 1, 'one original complete Linux invocation');
              const receipt = completed[0];

              assert.match(receipt.binarySha256, /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
              assert.match(receipt.manifestSha256, /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);

          } else if (process.platform === 'win32') {
            for (const name of ['windows-node24.log', 'windows-electron.log']) {
              const facts = rows(name);
              const gates = facts.filter(row => row.gate === 'owned-process-native-scenarios-only');

              assert.equal(gates.length, 1); assert.equal(controllers.length, 1);

            assert.equal(emulated.platform, 'win32-' + process.arch); assert.equal(emulated.nodeVersion, 'v24.21.0');

            assert.equal(emulated.releaseQualified, false);
            assert.deepEqual(emulated.wrappers, ['npm-node', 'generated-bun', 'opaque-cmd', 'positional-bat', 'npm-native']);
            assert.deepEqual(emulated.providers.map(row => row.provider), ['codex', 'opencode']);
            for (const row of emulated.providers) {
              for (const field of ['nativeReady', 'inputCompleted', 'neighborSurvivedPrimary', 'providerSurvivedScopedStops', 'cleanup']) assert.equal(row[field], true);
              assert.equal(row.registeredServices, 2); assert.equal(row.scopedStops, 2);
              for (const field of ['allocate', 'prepare', 'resume', 'release']) assert.equal(row.counts[field], 1);
              for (const field of ['serviceCapture', 'serviceStop', 'serviceSettle']) assert.equal(row.counts[field], 2);
              assert.ok(row.counts.stop >= 1 && row.counts.stop <= 4);
            }
            const controllers = rows('windows-emulated-provider.log').filter(row => row.gateController);
            assert.deepEqual(controllers, [{ gateController: 'drained', rootExitCode: 0, activeProcesses: 0 }]);
            native.push({ log: 'windows-emulated-provider.log', scope: 'captured Windows wrappers and Main Host Codex/V1 adapters with Node peers', receipt: emulated });
            const cleanupShape = (value, keys) => {
              assert.ok(value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value));
              assert.equal(Object.getPrototypeOf(value), Object.prototype);
              assert.equal(Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(value).length, 0);
              assert.deepEqual(Object.getOwnPropertyNames(value).sort(), [...keys].sort());
              for (const key of keys) assert.ok(Object.hasOwn(Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(value, key), 'value'));
              return value;
            };
            const cleanupRef = value => assert.ok(typeof value === 'string' && /^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}$/.test(value));
            const cleanupOwner = value => {
              const owner = cleanupShape(value, ['teamIncarnation', 'runId', 'laneId', 'processGeneration']);
              for (const key of ['teamIncarnation', 'runId', 'laneId']) cleanupRef(owner[key]);
              assert.ok(typeof owner.processGeneration === 'string' &&
                /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(owner.processGeneration));
              return owner;
            };
            const sourceReceipts = [
              ['codex', 'windows-source-codex-receipt.json', 'windows-source-codex.log'],
              ['claude', 'windows-source-claude-receipt.json', 'windows-source-claude.log'],
              ['opencode', 'windows-source-opencode-receipt.json', 'windows-source-opencode.log'],
            ];

              const proof = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(directory, receiptFile), 'utf8'));
              assert.equal(proof.kind, 'TEST_WINDOWS_EMULATED_SOURCE_PARITY'); assert.equal(proof.provider, provider);
              assert.equal(proof.sourceHead, process.env.HOST_PROCESS_SOURCE_HEAD);
              assert.equal(proof.platform, 'win32-' + process.arch); assert.equal(proof.nodeVersion, 'v24.21.0');
              assert.equal(proof.status, 'PASS'); assert.equal(proof.cleanup, true);
              assert.equal(proof.realProviderExecuted, false); assert.equal(proof.desktopQualified, false); assert.equal(proof.releaseQualified, false);
              assert.equal(Object.hasOwn(proof, 'providers'), false); assert.equal(Object.hasOwn(proof, 'wrappers'), false);
              assert.equal(proof.sourceScenarios.length, 1);
              const row = proof.sourceScenarios[0]; assert.equal(row.provider, provider);
              assert.equal(row.status, 'PASS'); assert.equal(row.stage, 'complete'); assert.equal(row.cleanup, true);
              assert.equal(row.realProviderExecuted, false); assert.equal(row.desktopQualified, false); assert.equal(row.releaseQualified, false);
              assert.equal(row.foreignScopeGrantRefusedBeforeAllocation, true);
              assert.notEqual(row.selections.A.revision, row.selections.B.revision);
              assert.equal(row.management.metadataRead, true); assert.equal(row.management.modelProbeCompleted, true);
              assert.equal(row.management.modelProbeInputs, 1); assert.equal(row.management.modelProbeReplayAllocated, false);
              assert.equal(row.management.metadataHostRetained, row.provider === 'opencode');
              assert.equal(row.teams.length, 2);
              assert.deepEqual(row.teams.map(team => team.source.revision), [row.selections.A.revision, row.selections.B.revision]);
              for (const field of ['currentB', 'retainedA', 'lookup']) assert.equal(row.cold[field], true);
              assert.equal(row.cold.physicalReplayAllocations, 0); assert.equal(row.cold.originalInputsReplayed, false);
              assert.deepEqual(row.cold.sourcePublishPendingAdmission, { admitted: 1, revoked: 1 });
              assert.equal(row.cold.sdkPeerCheckpointRestored, row.provider === 'claude');
              if (row.provider === 'claude') {
                assert.equal(row.cold.originalNativeSessionRetained, true);
                assert.equal(row.cold.source.revision, row.selections.A.revision);
              }
              if (row.provider === 'opencode') assert.equal(row.standalone.supported, false);

                for (const job of epoch.jobs) {
                  if (!Object.hasOwn(job, 'cleanupEvidence')) {
                    for (const field of ['resumed', 'stopped', 'drained', 'released', 'originalHandleAbsent']) assert.equal(job[field], true);
                    continue;
                  }
                  const evidence = cleanupShape(job.cleanupEvidence,
                    ['kind', 'mainEpoch', 'capability', 'allocatedOwner', 'stop', 'drain', 'release', 'observedCalls', 'witnessCaptured']);
                  assert.ok(Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(evidence), 'utf8') <= 4096);
                  assert.equal(evidence.kind, 'confirmed-no-local-dispatch'); assert.equal(evidence.witnessCaptured, false);
                  cleanupRef(evidence.mainEpoch); cleanupRef(evidence.capability);
                  assert.equal(evidence.mainEpoch, epoch.mainEpoch); assert.equal(evidence.capability, job.capability);
                  const owner = cleanupOwner(evidence.allocatedOwner);
                  const stop = cleanupShape(evidence.stop, ['state', 'attemptRef', 'receiptRef', 'receipt']);
                  assert.equal(stop.state, 'confirmed'); cleanupRef(stop.attemptRef); cleanupRef(stop.receiptRef);
                  const receipt = cleanupShape(stop.receipt, ['owner', 'attemptId', 'coverage', 'rootExited', 'proofDigest']);
                  assert.deepEqual(cleanupOwner(receipt.owner), owner); cleanupRef(receipt.attemptId);
                  assert.equal(receipt.attemptId, stop.attemptRef); assert.equal(receipt.coverage, 'no-local-dispatch');
                  assert.equal(receipt.rootExited, false);
                  assert.ok(typeof receipt.proofDigest === 'string' && /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(receipt.proofDigest));
                  const drain = cleanupShape(evidence.drain, ['state', 'afterStopReceiptRef']);
                  assert.equal(drain.state, 'complete'); assert.equal(drain.afterStopReceiptRef, stop.receiptRef);
                  const release = cleanupShape(evidence.release, ['state', 'receiptRef']);
                  assert.equal(release.state, 'released'); assert.equal(release.receiptRef, stop.receiptRef);
                  const observed = cleanupShape(evidence.observedCalls, ['allocate', 'prepare', 'resume']);
                  for (const phase of ['allocate', 'prepare', 'resume']) {
                    const counts = cleanupShape(observed[phase], ['calls', 'settled', 'returned']);
                    for (const field of ['calls', 'settled', 'returned']) assert.equal(counts[field], phase === 'allocate' ? 1 : 0);
                  }
                  assert.equal(job.root, null); assert.equal(job.entryStart, null); assert.equal(job.entryEnd, null);
                  assert.equal(job.resumed, false); assert.equal(job.originalHandleAbsent, false);
                  for (const field of ['stopped', 'drained', 'released']) assert.equal(job[field], true);
                }
              }
              const originalController = rows(log).filter(value => value.gateController);
              assert.deepEqual(originalController, [{ gateController: 'drained', rootExitCode: 0, activeProcesses: 0 }]);
              native.push({ log, scope: 'captured Main Host source A/B with finite ' + provider + ' peer', receipt: proof });
            }

          writeFileSync(join(directory, 'scope.json'), JSON.stringify({

            sourceHead: process.env.HOST_PROCESS_SOURCE_HEAD, platform: process.env.HOST_PROCESS_PLATFORM,
            nodeVersion: process.version, controlledContracts: true, retainedMainTransport: true,
            posixProcessGroups: process.platform !== 'win32', native,
            nativeProviderRuntimeQualified: false, darwinNativeRegistrationQualified: false,
            posixExecutableAdmissionQualified: false, desktopQualified: false, releaseQualified: false,
